rules.text: Cheap form: reached the line in 7+ of his last 10 with that side priced at 45c or less. YES on rebounds, the main line.
On fire from three: last 5 made threes at least 0.5 a game above his season, 44 percent or better from three on 4+ attempts a game. NO on made threes, the main line.
Shots up: last 5 field-goal attempts at least 2 a game above his season. NO on points + rebounds + assists, the main line.
Consistent: reached the line in 9+ of his last 10, and his last-10 spread is under 50 percent of his average. YES on assists, the main line.
Minutes up: last 5 games at least 5 minutes a game above his season. NO on any stat, the main line.
Cold streak: under the line in each of his last 3 games. YES on assists, the main line.
First NBA season, minutes up: last 5 games at least 2 minutes a game above his season. NO on any stat, the main line.
Minutes down: last 5 games at least 3 minutes a game below his season. YES on any stat, the main line.
